OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_BREW.name: Brew
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_BREW.description: Brew one potion or poison from your reagents ({Count} in the pouch). Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_BREW.descriptionDi: Not enough reagents for any recipe.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_CHEST.name: Chest
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_CHEST.description: Store cards and gear (they stop weighing) or take them back. Burden {Weight}/{Capacity}, in the chest: {Stored}. Free.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM_CHEST_STORE_PROMPT: Choose cards to put in the chest
SLAYTHEREQUIEM_CHEST_TAKE_PROMPT: Choose cards to take from the chest
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_FORGE.name: Forge
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_FORGE.description: Improve one equipped item by +1 (up to +2, [gold]Smithing[/gold] — +3). Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_FORGE.descriptionD: No equipped item can be improved further.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_SHORT_REST.name: Short Rest
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_SHORT_REST.descrip: Heal {Percent}% of max HP ({Heal}). Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_COOK.name: Cook
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_COOK.description: Cook a meal from reagents: its effect lasts 3 combats. Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_COOK.descriptionDi: Not enough reagents for any dish.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_ENCHANT.name: Enchant
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_ENCHANT.descriptio: Spend a soul stone ({Stones} left) to enchant an equipped item. Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
No soul stones or nothing to enchant.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_MEDITATE.name: Meditate
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_MEDITATE.descripti: +1 Stamina or Magicka tier until the end of the next combat. Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
Already meditated, or both tiers are at III.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_PRAY.name: Pray
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_PRAY.description: At this altar: change your blessing to its god, or atone (+1 righteousness, once per act). Costs {Cost} camp point(s), you have {Points}.
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_TRAIN.name: Train
OPTION_SLAYTHEREQUIEM_TRAIN.description: Level {Level}: spend {StatPoints} stat and {SkillPoints} skill points. Free.
